snapshot.capital_bootstrap: ₹2–6 lakh for fashion or demi-fine jewellery
snapshot.capital_scaled: ₹50 lakh–3 crore for gold, silver or lab-grown diamond stock and stores
snapshot.margin_d2c: 60–75% gross margin on fashion and demi-fine jewellery
snapshot.margin_production: 10–25% on gold and diamond pieces, where the metal is most of the price
snapshot.breakeven: 12–24 months for demi-fine; longer for fine jewellery
snapshot.distribution_note: Instagram and creators sell fashion pieces well; fine jewellery needs trust and a store or strong returns policy

tailwinds: Young buyers want everyday jewellery they can wear to work, between cheap fashion pieces and expensive gold.
Lab-grown diamonds have fallen sharply in price, opening a new category of affordable diamond jewellery.
Jaipur, Surat, Mumbai and Kolkata give you access to skilled karigars, stone cutters and manufacturers.
Gifting, weddings and festivals keep demand steady through the year.
headwinds: Tanishq, CaratLane, Giva and other well-funded brands spend heavily on marketing.
Gold and silver prices swing, which changes your costs and your customers' budgets.
Fashion jewellery is copied quickly, and cheap imports flood marketplaces.
Buyers need to trust purity and quality before paying for fine jewellery online.
angle_2026: Demi-fine silver and gold-plated jewellery and lab-grown diamonds have created a middle market that barely existed five years ago. In 2026, the jewellery brands that grow pick one style and one buyer, prove quality with hallmarks or certificates, and use Instagram to show the pieces being worn every day.
cost_basis: Estimated for a demi-fine or fashion jewellery brand using contract karigars and selling online, 2026 prices.

setup_costs.covers: Metal, plating, stones and making charges for 200–500 pieces

rows: ₹500–900 per piece; more from repeat and gifting orders
unit_economics.note: Jewellery is light and rarely returned for fit, so shipping and returns cost less than in clothing. Ad costs are the main expense.

investor_probes: How do you prove quality and purity to buyers online?
What does each first order cost in ads?
What share of buyers come back within six months?
How do you handle changes in gold or silver prices?
bootstrap_takeaway: Start with 30–50 designs in one style, produce in small batches, and let Instagram and early buyers tell you which pieces to reorder. Add fine jewellery only once you have a loyal customer base.
sourcing_edge: Jaipur (gemstones and silver), Surat (diamonds and lab-grown diamonds), Mumbai's Zaveri Bazaar and Kolkata's karigar workshops will make small batches. Working directly with a trusted karigar is cheaper than going through wholesalers.
licences: BIS hallmarking for gold jewellery (with HUID), and registration as a jeweller if you sell gold
Certificates from recognised labs for diamonds and lab-grown diamonds

hard_truths.title: Ads get expensive
hard_truths.text: Jewellery is one of the most competitive categories on Instagram and Google. Without repeat buyers or a strong community, ad costs will eat your margin.

hard_truths.title: Metal prices move
hard_truths.text: A rise in silver or gold prices hits your costs immediately. Update prices regularly and don't hold too much metal stock.

hard_truths.title: Plating wears off
hard_truths.text: Cheap plating fades in weeks and brings angry reviews. Pay for thicker plating and give care instructions.

hard_truths.title: Trust for fine jewellery
hard_truths.text: Selling gold or diamonds online needs certificates, easy returns and buyback promises. Big brands offer all of these.

plan_goal: The aim is ₹2 lakh in sales with a clear best-selling style.

plan.title: Define your style
steps: Pick one buyer and one style, such as office wear, minimal gold or bridal fashion.
Meet 3 karigars or manufacturers and compare samples.
Price your range against 3 competing brands.

plan.title: First collection
steps: Register your brand and open your store.

plan.title: Sell
steps: Send pieces to 20–30 creators in your style.
Run small ad tests on your best 5 designs.
Offer gift wrapping and personalised notes.

plan.title: Review the numbers
steps: Check ad cost per order and repeat purchases.
Plan a festive or wedding collection.
